operations.name: Earnest N. Lamb

expected.charges: Disobeying orders; refusal of military service (World War I court-martial of a conscientious objector)

updates.sentence:
Held at Fort Leavenworth.

Assigned to the 57th Company, 165th Depot Brigade at Camp Travis, Texas, and placed in the conscientious-objector detachment. The archival catalogue identifies him among 41 objectors court-martialed there for refusing to wear the uniform and cites general court-martial proceedings dated June 7, 1918. That document date is not entered as a sentencing or prison-admission date; actual custody endpoints remain unverified.
